verdict.rationale: Brex's Team API explicitly manages users, departments, and cards, and marketing docs describe issuing vendor/team-specific cards with per-transaction limits and budget-based spend controls, supporting role-based card issuance. However, evidence never explicitly confirms physical (vs. virtual-only) card issuance or details role/permission granularity for card assignment. missing for 10: explicit mention of physical card issuance, detailed role-based permission model, independent corroboration of the physical card program.
